kolossayilo unna parishuddhulaku, anagaa kreesthu nandu vishvaasulaina sahodarulaku.
dhevuni chitthamuvalana kreesthuyesu aposthaludaina paulunu sahodarudaina thimothiyunu shubhamanicheppi vraayunadhi. Mana thandriyaina dhevuni nundi krupayu samaadhaanamunu meeku kalugunu gaaka.

paralokamandu meekoraku unchabadina nireekshananubatti, kreesthuyesunandu meeku kaligiyunna vishvaasamunu goorchiyu, parishuddhulandarimeeda meekunna premanu goorchiyu, memu vini yellappudu mee nimitthamu praarthanacheyuchu,
mana prabhuvagu yesu kreesthuyokka thandriyaina dhevuniki kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchuchunnaamu.
meeyoddhaku vachina suvaartha satyamunugoorchina bodhavalana aa nireekshananugoorchi meeru inthakumundu vintiri.
ee suvaartha sarvalokamulo phalinchuchu, vyaapinchuchunnattugaa meeru dhevuni krupanugoorchi vini satyamugaa grahinchina naatanundi meelo sayithamu phalinchuchu vyaapinchuchunnadhi.
epaphraa anu maa priyudaina thoodidaasunivalana meeru ee sangathulanu nerchukontiri.
athadu maa vishayamulo nammakamaina kreesthu parichaarakudu; athadu aatmayandali mee premanu maaku telipinavaadu.
anduchetha ee sangathi vininanaatanundi memunu mee nimitthamu praarthana cheyuta maanaka, meeru sampoorna gnaanamunu aatma sambandhamaina vivekamuganulavaarunu,
aayana chitthamunu poornamugaa grahinchinavaarunai, prathi satkaaryamulo saphalulaguchu, dhevuni vishayamaina gnaana mandu abhivruddhi ponduchu, anni vishayamulalo prabhuvunu santhooshapettunatlu,

aayanaku thaginattugaa naduchukonavalenaniyu, aanandamuthoo koodina poornamaina orpunu deerghashaanthamunu kanuparachunatlu aayana mahima shakthinibatti sampoorna balamuthoo balaparachabadavalenaniyu,
thejovaasulaina parishuddhula svaasthyamulo paalivaaramagutaku manalanu paatrulanugaachesina thandriki meeru kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellimpavalenaniyu dhevuni bathimaalu chunnaamu.
aayana manalanu andhakaarasambandhamaina adhikaaramulonundi vidudalachesi, thaanu preminchina thana kumaaruniyokka raajyanivaasulanugaa chesenu.
aa kumaaruniyandu manaku vimochanamu, anagaa paapakshamaapana kaluguchunnadhi.
aayana adrushyadhevuni svaroopiyai sarvasrushtiki aadhisambhoothudai yunnaadu.

yelayanagaa aakaashamandunnaviyu bhoomiyandunna viyu, drushyamainavigaani, adrushyamainavigaani, avi sinhaasanamulainanu prabhutvamulainanu pradhaanulainanu adhikaaramulainanu, sarvamunu aayanayandu srujimpa badenu, sarvamunu aayanadvaaraanu aayananubattiyu srujimpabadenu.
aayana annitikante mundhugaa unna vaadu; aayane samasthamunaku aadhaarabhoothudu.
sanghamu anu shareeramunaku aayane shirassu; aayanaku annitilo praamukhyamu kalugu nimitthamu, aayana aadhiyaiyundi mruthulalonundi lechutalo aadhisambhoothudaayenu.
aayanayandu sarvasampoornatha nivasimpavalenaniyu,

aayana siluvarakthamuchetha sandhichesi, aayanadvaaraa samasthamunu, avi bhoolokamandunnavainanu paraloka mandunnavainanu, vaatinannitini aayanadvaaraa thanathoo samaadhaanaparachukona valenaniyu thandri abheeshtamaayenu.
mariyu gathakaala mandu dhevuniki doorasthulunu, mee dush‌kriyalavalana mee manassulo virodhabhaavamugalavaarunai yundina mimmunu kooda
thana sannidhini parishuddhulugaanu nirdoshulugaanu niraparaadhulugaanu niluvabettutaku aayana maansayukthamaina dhehamandu maranamuvalana ippudu mimmunu samaadhaanaparachenu.

punaadhimeeda kattabadinavaarai sthiramugaa undi, meeru vinnattiyu, aakaashamukrinda unna samasthasrushtiki prakatimpabadinattiyu ee suvaarthavalana kalugu nireekshananundi tolagipoka, vishvaasamandu nilichi yundinayedala idi meeku kalugunu. Paulanu nenu aa suvaarthaku parichaarakudanaithini.

ippudu meekoraku nenu anubhavinchuchunna shramala yandu santhooshinchuchu, sanghamu anu aayana shareeramu koraku kreesthu padinapaatlalo koduvaina vaatiyandu naa vanthu naa shareeramandu sampoornamu cheyuchunnaanu.
dhevuni vaakyamunu, anagaa yugamulalonu tharamulalonu marugu cheyabadiyunna marmamunu sampoornamugaa praka tinchutaku,
mee nimitthamu naaku appagimpabadina dhevuni yerpaatu prakaaramu, nenu aa sanghamunaku parichaara kudanaithini.

anyajanulalo ee marmamuyokka mahi maishvaryamu ettido adhi, anagaa mee yandunna kreesthu, mahima nireekshanayai yunnaadanu sangathini dhevudu thana parishuddhulaku teliyaparachagori yippudu aa marmamunu vaariki bayaluparachenu.

prathi manushyuni kreesthunandu sampoornunigaa chesi aayanayeduta niluvabettavalenani, samasthavidhamulaina gnaanamuthoo memu prathi manushyuniki buddhicheppuchu, prathi manushyuniki bodhinchuchu, aayananu prakatinchuchunnaamu.
andu nimitthamu naalo balamugaa, kaaryasiddhikalugajeyu aayana kriyaashakthini batti nenu poraaduchu prayaasapaduchunnaanu.
mee korakunu, lavodikaya vaari korakunu, shareera reethigaa naa mukhamu choodanivaarandarikorakunu

nenu enthagaa poraaduchunnaano meeru telisikonagoru chunnaanu. Vaaru premayandu athukabadi, sampoorna grahimpuyokka sakalaishvaryamu kaliginavaarai, dhevuni marmamaiyunna kreesthunu, spashtamugaa telisikonnavaarai, thama hrudayamulalo aadharanapondavalenani vaarandari koraku poraaduchunnaanu.
buddhi gnaanamula sarva sampadalu aayanayandhe gupthamulaiyunnavi.
evadainanu chakkani maatalachetha mimmunu mosaparachakundunatlu ee sangathini cheppuchunnaanu.
nenu shareeravishayamulo dooramugaa unnanu aatmavishayamulo meethookooda undi, mee yogyamaina pravarthananu kreesthunandali mee sthiravishvaasamunu chuchi aanandinchuchunnaanu.
kaavuna meeru prabhuvaina kreesthuyesunu angeekarinchina vidhamugaa aayanayandu verupaarinavaarai, yintivale kattabaduchu,
meeru nerchukonina prakaaramugaa vishvaasamandu sthiraparachabaduchu, kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchutayandu vistharinchuchu, aayanayandundi naduchukonudi.

aayananu anusarimpaka manushyula paaramparyaachaara munu, anagaa ee lokasambandhamaina moolapaathamulanu anusarinchi mosakaramaina nirarthaka thatva gnaanamuchetha mimmunu cherapattukoni povuvaadevadaina undunemo ani jaagratthagaa undudi.
yelayanagaa dhevatvamuyokka sarvaparipoornatha shareeramugaa kreesthunandu nivasinchu chunnadhi;
mariyu aayanayandu meerunu sampoornulai yunnaaru; aayana samastha pradhaanulakunu adhikaarulakunu shirassai yunnaadu;
meerunu, kreesthu sunnathiyandu, shareerecchalathoo koodina svabhaavamunu visarjinchi aayanayandu chethulathoo cheyabadani sunnathi pondithiri.
meeru baapthisma mandu aayanathoo kooda paathipettabadinavaarai aayananu mruthulalonundi lepina dhevuni prabhaavamandu vishvasinchuta dvaaraa aayanathookooda lechithiri.
mariyu aparaadhamula valananu, shareeramandu sunnathipondaka yundutavalananu, meeru mruthulai yundagaa,

dhevudu vraatharoopakamaina aagnalavalana manameeda runamugaanu manaku virodhamugaanu nundina patramunu mekulathoo siluvaku kotti, daanimeedi chevraathanu thudichivesi,manaku addamulekunda daanini etthi vesi mana aparaadhamulanannitini kshaminchi,
aayanathookooda mimmunu jeevimpachesenu;aayana pradhaanulanu adhikaarulanu niraayudhulanugaachesi, siluvachetha jayotsavamuthoo vaarini patti techi baahaatamugaa vedukaku kanuparachenu.
kaabatti annapaanamula vishayamulonainanu, panduga amaavaasya vishraanthidinamu anuvaati vishayamulonainanu, meeku theerpu theercha nevanikini avakaashamiyyakudi.
ivi raabovuvaati chaayayegaani nija svaroopamu kreesthulo unnadhi
athi vinayaasakthudai dhevadoothaa raadhanayandu icchakaligi, thaanu chuchinavaatinigoorchi goppagaa cheppukonuchu, thana shareerasambandhamaina manassuvalana ooraka upponguchu,

shirassunu hatthukonani vaadevadunu mee bahumaanamunu apaharimpaniyyakudi; aa shirassumoolamugaa sarvashareeramu keellachethanu naramula chethanu poshimpabadi athukabadinadai, dhevunivalana kalugu vruddhithoo abhivruddhi ponduchunnadhi.
meeru kreesthuthookooda lokamuyokka moolapaatha mula vishayamai mruthipondinavaaraithe lokamulo braduku chunnattugaa
manushyula aagnalanu paddhathulanu anusarinchichetha pattukonavaddu,ruchichoodavaddu, muttavaddu anu vidhu laku meeru lobadanela?
avanniyu vaadukonutachetha nashinchipovunu.

attivi svecchaaraadhana vishayamulonu vinaya vishayamulonu, dhehashiksha vishayamulonu gnaana roopakamainavaniyenchabaduchunnavegaani, shareerecchaanigraha vishayamulo emaatramunu ennika cheyadaginavi kaavu.
meeru kreesthuthookooda lepabadinavaaraithe painunna vaatine vedakudi, akkada kreesthu dhevuni kudipaarshvamuna koorchundiyunnaadu.
painunna vaatimeedanegaani, bhoosambandhamainavaatimeeda manassu pettukonakudi;
yelayanagaa meeru mruthipondithiri, mee jeevamu kreesthuthookooda dhevuniyandu daachabadiyunnadhi.
manaku jeevamai yunna kreesthu pratyakshamainappudu meerunu aayanathookooda mahimayandu pratyakshaparachabaduduru.
kaavuna bhoomimeedanunna mee avayavamulanu, anagaa jaaratvamunu, apavitrathanu, kaamaathurathanu, duraashanu, vigrahaaraadhanayaina dhanaapekshanu champi veyudi.
vaativalana dhevuni ugratha avidheyula meediki vachunu.
poorvamu vaari madhya jeevinchinappudu meerunu veetini anusarinchi naduchukontiri.
ippudaithe meeru, kopamu, aagrahamu, dushtatvamu, dooshana, meenota boothulu anu veetinannitini visarjinchudi.
okanithoo okadu abaddha maadakudi;yelayanagaa praachinasvabhaavamunu daani kriyalathoo kooda
meeru parityajinchi, gnaanamu kalugu nimitthamu daanini srushtinchinavaani polikachoppuna noothana parachabaduchunna naveenasvabhaavamunu dharinchukoni yunnaaru.

ittivaarilo greesudheshasthudani yoodudani bhedamu ledu; sunnathi pondutayani sunnathi pondaka povutayani bhedamu ledu; paradheshiyani sithiyanudani daasudani svathantrudani ledugaani, kreesthe sarvamunu andarilo unnavaadunai yunnaadu.
kaagaa, dhevunichetha erparachabadinavaarunu parishuddhulunu priyulunainavaariki thaginatlu, meeru jaaligala manassunu, dayaalutvamunu, vinayamunu, saatvikamunu, deerghashaantha munu dharinchukonudi.
evadainanu thanaku haanichesenani yokadanukonina yedala okani nokadu sahinchuchu okani nokadu kshaminchudi, prabhuvu mimmunu kshaminchinalaaguna meerunu kshaminchudi.
veetannitipaina paripoornathaku anu bandhamaina premanu dharinchukonudi.
kreesthu anu grahinchu samaadhaanamu mee hrudayamulalo elu chunda niyyudi; indukorake meerokka shareeramugaa piluvabadithiri; mariyu kruthagnulai yundudi.

sangeethamulathoonu keerthanalathoonu aatmasambandhamaina padyamulathoonu okaniki okadu bodhinchuchu, buddhi cheppuchu krupaa sahi thamugaa mee hrudayamulalo dhevunigoorchi gaanamu cheyuchu, samasthavidhamulaina gnaanamuthoo kreesthu vaakyamu meelo samruddhigaa nivasimpaniyyudi.
mariyu maatachetha gaani kriyachetha gaani, meeremi chesinanu prabhuvaina yesudvaaraa thandriyaina dhevuniki kruthagnathaasthuthulu chellinchuchu, samasthamunu aayana perata cheyudi.
bhaaryalaaraa, mee bharthalaku vidheyulai yundudi; idi prabhuvunubatti yukthamaiyunnadhi.
bharthalaaraa, mee bhaaryalanu preminchudi, vaarini nishthurapettakudi.
pillalaaraa, anni vishayamulalo mee thalidandrula maata vinudi; idi prabhuvunubatti mechukonathaginadhi.
thandrulaaraa, mee pillala manassu krungakundunatlu vaariki kopamu puttimpakudi.

daasulaaraa, manushyulanu santhooshapettu vaarainattu kantiki kanabadavalenani kaaka, prabhuvunaku bhayapaduchu shuddhaanthaḥkaranagalavaarai, shareeramunubatti mee yajamaanulainavaariki anni vishayamulalo vidheyulai yundudi.
prabhuvuvalana svaasthyamunu prathiphalamugaa pondudumani yeruguduru ganuka,
meeremi chesinanu adhi manushyula nimitthamu kaaka prabhuvu nimitthamani mana sphoorthigaa cheyudi, meeru prabhuvaina kreesthunaku daasulai yunnaaru.
anyaayamu chesinavaaniki thaanu chesina anyaayamukoladhi marala labhinchunu, pakshapaathamundadu.
yajamaanulaaraa, paralokamulo meekunu yaja maanudunnaadani yerigi, nyaayamainadhiyu dharmaanu saara mainadhiyu mee daasulayedala cheyudi.
praarthanayandu nilukadagaa undi kruthagnathagalavaarai daaniyandu melakuvagaa undudi.
mariyu nenu bandhakamulalo unchabadutaku kaaranamaina kreesthu marmamunu goorchi nenu bodhimpavalasina vidhamugaane
aa marmamunu velladiparachunatlu vaakyamu chepputaku anukoolamaina samayamu dhevudu dayacheyavalenani maakoraku praarthinchudi.
samayamu poniyyaka sadviniyogamu chesikonuchu, sanghamunaku velupati vaariyedala gnaanamu kaligi naduchu konudi.
prathi manushyuniki elaagu pratyuttharamiyya valeno adhi meeru telisikonutakai mee sambhaashana uppu vesinattu ellappudu ruchigaladhigaanu krupaasahithamugaanu undaniyyudi.
priyasahodarudunu, prabhuvunandu nammakamaina parichaarakudunu, naa thoodi sevakudunaina thukiku nannugoorchina sangathulanniyu meeku teliyajeyunu.
meeru maa sthithi telisikonunatlunu mee hrudayamulanu athadu aadarinchu natlunu,
athanini athanithookooda nammakamaina priyasaho darudaina onesimunu meeyoddhaku pampuchunnaanu; ithadu mee yoddhanundi vachinavaade; veerikkadi sangathulanniyu meeku teliyajethuru.

naathookooda cheralo unna aristhaarkunu, barnabaaku sameepagnaathiyaina maarkunu meeku vandhanamulu cheppu chunnaaru; ee maarkunugoorchi meeru aagnalu pondithiri, ithadu meeyoddhaku vachinayedala ithani cherchukonudi.

mariyu yoosthu anu yesukooda meeku vandhanamulu cheppuchunnaadu. Veeru sunnathi pondinavaarilo cherina vaaru, veerumaatrame dhevuni raajyamu nimitthamu naa jatha panivaarai yunnaaru, veerivalana naaku aadharana kaligenu.

meelo okadunu kreesthuyesu daasudunaina epaphraa meeku vandhanamulu cheppuchunnaadu; meeru sampoornulunu, prathi vishayamulo dhevuni chitthamunugoorchi sampoornaatma nishchayathagalavaarunai nilukadagaa undavalenani yithadellappudunu meekoraku thana praarthanalalo poraaduchunnaadu.
ithadu meekorakunu, lavodikayavaari korakunu, hiyeraa polivaarikorakunu bahu prayaasapaduchunnaadani yithaninigoorchi saakshyamichuchunnaanu.
lookaa anu priyudaina vaidyudunu, dhemaayu meeku vandhanamulu cheppuchunnaaru.
lavodikayalo unna sahodarulakunu, numphaakunu, vaari yinta unna sanghamunakunu vandhanamulu cheppudi.
ee patrika meeru chadhivinchukonina tharuvaatha lavodikaya vaari sanghamulonu chadhivinchudi; lavodikayaku vraasi pampina patrikanu meerunu chadhivinchukonudi.
mariyu prabhuvunandu neeku appa gimpabadina paricharyanu neraverchutaku daanigoorchi jaagrattha padumani arkhipputhoo cheppudi.
paulanu nenu svahasthamuthoo naa vandhanamulu vraayuchunnaanu; naa bandhakamulanu gnaapakamu chesikonudi. Krupa meeku thoodaiyundunu gaaka.
